info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Loan Offer API
info.description: The Update Loan Offer API allows authorized users to modify existing loan offers provided to applicants. This endpoint is primarily designed for financial institutions and loan managers who need to adjust offer details based on evolving circumstances or applicant requirements. By enabling updates to loan offers, it supports dynamic interactions in the loan application process, ensuring that offers remain relevant and competitive. Typical users include loan officers and application processors managing multiple client cases.

put.summary: Update an offer for a specific loan application.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to update an existing offer associated with a particular loan application by providing the necessary details. Ensure that you have the required permissions to perform this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the loan offer for a specific loan application identified by RES-100045. It must include all necessary details for the loan offer as specified in the schema.
